t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone page. A small wordmark, breadcrumb and mono page index on a hairline header rule. A large light-weight sans headline over two lines. Centre: one matte white polypropylene skid in soft 3D isometric render, even studio light, translucent pale-blue water in a clear pipe loop. Hairline leader lines with small square markers run from points on the skid out to numbered callouts, each a sans title, a mono code line and a short description, for <CONTENT>. Calm, precise.
signature_idea: Each document the loop ships with is tied by a hairline to the part of the white PP skid it describes.
strengths: callout map ties abstract documents to physical parts of the skid
matte white PP and pale water show the actual product material
light headline, mono codes and steel-blue numbers are on-brand
limestone ground and space feel calm and precise
buildable as image plus positioned callouts
weaknesses: headline duplicates the page title and section title as two lines
invented figures and standard numbers would be mistaken for facts
leader end points are arbitrary; most do not land on the part the document describes
no navy anchor; the page is all light
brand_fit_why: Limestone, white PP, steel-blue numerals, light sans and mono codes fit; the soft render is calm but the callout targets are vague.
